title: Take the middle
summary: Start the game with pawns in the centre.

steps.md: The four squares in the **middle** are the best seats in the house: d4, e4, d5 and e5.
Pieces in the middle can go everywhere. Pieces in the corner are stuck!

steps.prompt: Put a pawn in the middle with a big step!
steps.hint: The pawns in front of the king or queen.

steps.prompt: You are Black. Answer in the middle too!
steps.explain: You grab your share of the middle!
steps.hint: Push a middle pawn two squares.

steps.question: Which of these is a middle square?
steps.explain: e4 is one of the four centre squares.
